# netactuate_platform_incident_history (Data Source)

Reads a Platform Incident History.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_platform_incident_history" "example" {
  location = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location` (String) Location to query. This is a string and accepts either a numeric location ID or an IATA code, for example 3 or sjc.

### Read-Only

- `historic` (List of Object) Historic platform incident events for the requested location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--historic))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--historic"></a>
### Nested Schema for `historic`

Read-Only:

- `components` (List of String)
- `containers` (List of String)
- `end_time` (String)
- `event_id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `start_time` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `type` (String)
